subject: Handling list of numerous vectors with DATA_STRUCT ?

messages.author: 2ad15cb985a36fb0
messages.subject: Handling list of numerous vectors with DATA_STRUCT ?
parts:
Hello,

My  data consists of about 150 time series of different size. 

Is there a better way between using a DATA_ARRAY and complete "short" time series with any value I could select and delete in the C++ file, or use a DATA_STRUCT? In this last case, would anyone have an example of how I could define the structure? Defining each vector individually is probably not the best way and I do not manage to write the appropriate loop.

Best wishes,

Marie

messages.author: 90b303eef43fd993
messages.subject: Re: [TMB users] Handling list of numerous vectors with DATA_STRUCT ?
parts:
How about representing the multiple time series as a vector and a factor ?
Example:

In R we can do

x <- 1:10
f <- gl(2,5)
spl <- split(x,f)

In TMB:

PARAMETER_VECTOR(x);
DATA_FACTOR(f);
vector<vector<Type> > spl = split(x, f);

You can loop through the split like this:

for (int i=0; i<NLEVELS(f); i++) {
  vector<Type> xi = spl(i);
}
